facts_raw.Program: MedTech Innovator Heart & Brain Health Accelerator
facts_raw.Capital Type: No standalone guaranteed cash; part of MTI accelerator/competition
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: Funding/awards through broader MedTech Innovator process; specialty track participation itself is not a guaranteed investment
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Seed, Series A or Series B medical technology focused on prevention, diagnosis, treatment or secondary prevention in heart/brain health.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 未公开明确统一要求；按项目地点 Virtual + US events 和当期 cohort 安排确认。
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: MedTech / Health / Bio；AI / AI-native；阶段以 Seed–Series B 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 缺少核心技术/IP、仅做轻量同质化应用或贸易型项目；只有想法、无 MVP/traction 的极早期项目
facts_raw.Notes: Strong specialty track for medtech companies in heart/brain health; part of core MTI process.

facts.Program: MedTech Innovator Heart & Brain Health Accelerator

facts.Foundshore Best Fit: MedTech / Health / Bio; AI / AI-native; primarily at the Seed–Series B stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Projects without core technology or IP, including undifferentiated apps and trading businesses; Idea-only projects without an MVP or traction
facts.Notes: Strong specialty track for medtech companies in heart/brain health; part of core MTI process.
